content.text:
The suite is green now. The test wasn't flaky, so I fixed the code and didn't skip the test.

`invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`). The comment says invoices are dated in UTC, and the test sets `TZ=Asia/Tokyo`. In Tokyo, 23:30 UTC on March 5 is already March 6, so it failed every time on a Tokyo server. It would also have dated real invoices wrong in production. I switched to the `getUTC*` equivalents.
